title: Target-population construction for G5 and the L7 half of G6

specification_status.supersedes: the earlier statement that the repository contained no Phase G specification and no gate number
specification_status.statement: This file previously asserted that no Phase G specification and no gate number existed. The project's engineering guide defines Phase G (weeks 13-15, 'measure everything': headline tables, external benchmark transfer, laptop latency) and defines Gate G7 for it. The guide is a project document held outside this repository; that is a filing problem, not an absent specification, and it must not be reported as one.

gate.statement: the target slice carries both correctness classes and the headline comparison is computable
gate.fail_condition: G7 fails when no target slice exists on which a ranking is defined
conditions: both correctness classes on every evaluated slice
headline comparison computable (a legal-aware arm and a baseline arm both defined on the target slice)
judge coverage reported per slice, as a column
undefined values stated with an explicit reason code
gate.status_reason: L7 carries a single correctness class (0 correct of 100 items), which is the guide's own stated fail condition

retained_prerequisites: PHASE-E.md §7.4 - build a target population containing both classes before claiming target-slice AUROC or the complete G5 criterion
PHASE-E.md structural G5 finding - a slice with both correctness classes on which the detector both fires and stays silent
PHASE-F.md §12.1 - build a target slice with both correctness classes so the L7 stratum is evaluable

audit.note: read-only; the detector fields come from Phase D and the scores from Phase E, both stored in this run

screen.expectation_note: 24 items x 10 samples is the size of the Phase A pilot (scripts/06_pilot.py), which is the project's own precedent for a go/no-go screen

yield_planning.note: PLANNING parameters for a cost estimate, not gates. They are passed explicitly to jurisuq.target.items_needed so the assumption is visible in the report.
yield_planning.basis: a usable two-class evaluation population needs enough correct items for an AUROC interval to be meaningful; 15 is the planning floor used for the Phase G cost estimate and is NOT a threshold from the engineering guide

forbidden_operations: change ace_max, c_verify, c_abstain, the 0.80 conformal target, or the phaseE-v1 split
select data, drop items, or relabel examples to make G7 pass
report a pooled slice statistic as if it were a slice result
report a value for a measurement that was not instrumented

methods_missing.lexical_similarity: declared in the guide's list but not implemented; only the entailment backend exists
methods_missing.p_true: no token log-probabilities were stored in any frozen run, so the arm is measured absent

evaluation_matrix.orientation: every score is oriented so that larger means more uncertain; AUROC detects incorrect answers (higher is better)
evaluation_matrix.confident_wrong_definition: wrong answer whose uncertainty lies in the lowest quartile
evaluation_matrix.label_definition: the judge's verdict on the modal answer
slices_missing: external benchmark task - deferred pending dataset and licensing approval
generator_arms_present: qwen2.5-7b-instruct, p2-structured, M=10 (frozen Phase A arm)
generator_arms_missing: second laptop size or quantisation - deferred, cost and storage review
one API model at evaluation time - deferred, not approved
evaluation_matrix.pooling_policy: slices are never pooled; pooled_reference raises unless both slices are present and is tagged reference-only
evaluation_matrix.headline_partition: the frozen pair-grouped evaluation partition, the only partition on which every method is out of sample

undefined_reason_codes.single_correctness_class: the slice has one class, so no ranking metric is defined
undefined_reason_codes.constant_score: the method emits one distinct value, so the ranking and the fixed-coverage selection are tie-break artefacts
undefined_reason_codes.method_not_implemented: the method is declared but this repository has no implementation for it
undefined_reason_codes.logprobs_absent: the frozen runs stored no token log-probabilities
undefined_reason_codes.no_items_with_a_score_and_a_label: the method produced no score on any resolved item of this slice
undefined_reason_codes.score_outside_unit_interval: the score is not a probability, so calibration metrics do not apply
undefined_reason_codes.harm_class_absent: no harm class is recorded, so the harm-weighted risk is undefined
undefined_reason_codes.degenerate_label_distribution: the metric function returned no finite value on this population
undefined_reason_codes.not_instrumented: the stages were not timed or sampled in any frozen run

stage1_latency.definition: gen_latency_s + scoring_s per item, legal modules excluded

full_cascade_latency.reason: relation, detection, estimation and decision stages are not instrumented in the frozen runs
full_cascade_latency.requires: a laptop run; pass --timings to scripts/43_measure_deployment.py

peak_resident_memory.reason: no memory sampling exists in any Phase A-F run
peak_resident_memory.requires: psutil or getrusage during a live query, with the sampling method recorded

configuration_actually_measured.quantisation: not recorded in the run metadata

deployment.percentile_convention: linear interpolation, the numpy default, stated because a p95 under another convention is not comparable

preserved: frozen Phase A-F datasets, runs, splits, thresholds and results
